items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: So the woman that owned the drug store, Miss Ferguson, she knew that I loved malted milk

ctx.x: What did your grandmother and mother think?

They didn't know it. They just thought I was sick, you know. So the woman that owned the drug store, Miss Ferguson, she knew that I loved malted milk with nutmeg in it, you know. So anytime that she had a delivery out that way she would always send me a malted milk. And malted milk and milk, you remember milk when it had cream on the top in the bottles. That was the only thing that would stay in my stomach, no solid foods at all for about a month and half before I could eat any solid food.
And then I was sorry I could because it wouldn't stay. Food wouldn't maintain the food value. It would just run straight through me. Well, I overcome that.
